title: DRC Ebola Death Toll Passes 4,000 as Health Workers Protest Delayed Pay
detail: DRC's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak passed 4,000 deaths in early October 2026: Health Ministry figures showed 4,018 deaths among about 8,300 confirmed cases, while health workers protested delayed payments. WHO data as of Sept 29 listed 8,224 confirmed cases and 3,982 deaths; Ituri remains the most affected province.

media.caption: Ebola death toll passes 4,000 in Congo

confidenceReason: Two Tier-2 outlets report Health Ministry figures.
